observations: Photos show a used vehicle gearbox/transmission assembly on a floor, with wiring harnesses and multiple hoses/lines attached.

Photo 1 shows the transmission from another angle with a large electrical connector/wiring and a label sticker on the casing (text not readable).

claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese parts and gearbox
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos show a gearbox but do not confirm the seller is a dealer or that it is Japanese-specific.

risks.risk: Wrong transmission type/fitment (gearbox code mismatch) for the buyer’s vehicle.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the transmission identification plate/gearbox code (sticker/engraving) and the vehicle make/model/year it fits.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used gearbox with unknown fitment risk (worst case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (may be faulty internally, noisy, or slipping).
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox being tested (bench test or installed test) showing it engages all gears and does not leak.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: treat as faulty/needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (linkages, sensors, solenoids, mounting brackets) not shown in photos.
risks.proof: Photo checklist: show all included items laid out (sensors/solenoids, harness connectors, mounting brackets, bolts) and confirm what is included/excluded.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: missing small parts).

risks.risk: Fluid leaks or damaged seals/case cracks.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seams, drain/plug areas, and any wet/oily spots; plus a short wipe-and-check after running/tilting.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may leak (worst case: plan for reseal).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the gearbox code/part number label on the casing (the sticker text in photo 1 is not readable).
Tell the exact vehicle it came from (make/model/year/engine) and the gearbox code that matches it.
Provide a short video showing the gearbox engaging gears (or installed test) and confirm no leaks.
List what is included in the package (starter/torque converter/flexplate not applicable unless stated, sensors, harness, mounting brackets) and send photos of all included parts laid out.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a used gearbox/transmission assembly, but the key details needed to price it safely (exact gearbox code/fitment and working condition) are not readable or proven. Without that, any price would be guesswork.
